summary: Builds the camera projection matrix (orthographic when a2 bit 0x10 is set, perspective otherwise) and/or the view matrix, gated by flag bits in a2: flag value 4 selects the projection update, flag value 2 the view update, flag value 8 an additional sub_55CC20 update. Projection math reads near/far planes (this+4, this+8), field of view (this+28), aspect (this+32) and a camera flag byte at this+128; both matrices are uploaded through EnumToVTableCallMapper and the update is bracketed by EmptyStubWithFlagCheck calls.

operations.description: Run the projection-matrix update only when (a2 & 4) is non-zero.
Call EmptyStubWithFlagCheck(2, 0) before building the projection matrix.
Zero the 16-float local matrix v12 via memset.
Branch on (a2 & 0x10): orthographic projection path when set, perspective path otherwise.
Orthographic path: derive scale from far plane (this+8) minus near plane (this+4) as 1/delta; fill v12[0]=0.2, v12[5]=0.2, v12[10]=1/delta, v12[11]=0.0, v12[14]=near * v12[10], v12[15]=1.0.

Perspective path: compute v10=1/(this+28), v6=1/(this+32), v7=(this+8)/((this+8)-(this+4)), v11=-(this+4)*v7; negate v10 when byte at this+128 has bit 0x10 set; fill v12[0], v12[5]=v6, v12[10]=v7, v12[11]=1.0, v12[14]=v11, v12[15]=0.0.
Call EmptyStubWithFlagCheck(1, 0) after building the projection matrix.
Upload the projection matrix: EnumToVTableCallMapper(4, v12).
Run the view-matrix update when (a2 & 2) is non-zero.
Upload the view matrix from this + 348: EnumToVTableCallMapper(2, this + 348).
When (a2 & 8) is set, run the additional camera update and return its result.
Call sub_55CC20(this) for the additional camera update.
Return the result produced by the last executed branch (sub_55CC20 result or the prior EnumToVTableCallMapper result).
